sections.title: Service and customs tariff code list

html:
16.4.1Background of the sign-in screen

The background image of the Infinity start screen and the logo above the menu can be uploaded and selected here.

16.4.2Service and customs tariff code list

The place for uploading and administering the service and customs tariff codes.

16.4.3Unit of measure list

The units of measure used by the system can be recorded with the Create button.

16.4.4Template settings

The place for customising the documents used by the system (for example invoice, delivery note).

In the first point, textual content can be added:

In the image list you can upload the images you want to use:

In the template setting, specify the header (its right and left side) and the footer of the documents used by the modules. The options are provided by the texts and images added earlier.

In the e-mail template setting you can customise the documents of the e-mail templates (for example invoice sending, payment reminder):

16.4.5Setup wizard

The setup wizard helps you configure the system for use step by step. It starts automatically at the first sign-in, but it can be started at any time later.

  1. Selecting the country (where you use it and where you invoice):

  1. Entering company data (required by law for invoicing):

  1. Setting up sites:

  1. Defining warehouses for the sites (own/consignment stock, returns warehouse):

  1. Selecting currencies:

  1. Invoice and receipt blocks (by default 1 customer and 1 supplier):

  1. Entering VAT rates (with the help of your accountant):

  1. Recording bank accounts (with IBAN and SWIFT code):

  1. Connecting NAV Online Invoice (a legal obligation — failing to do so results in a fine):

✖ Mandatory

The technical user is created in the NAV online system: https://onlineszamla.nav.gov.hu/felhasznalok/uj/technikai

Pressing the Back to home page button completes the basic configuration.
